Which country has a flag consisting of horizontal stripes of red, white, and blue, arranged from top to bottom?

questions.question: The flag of Chad displays three vertical stripes in blue, yellow, and red, while the flag of Romania also has three vertical stripes but in blue, yellow, and red order. In contrast, the flags of Indonesia and Monaco consist of two horizontal stripes using only red and white, distinguishing them from Chad's flag.
